Last updated: October 24, 2026

Fahim uses the email address you enter only to create your account and send verification codes.

When you choose to record your pet for analysis, the recording is sent to Google's Gemini API for an estimate of your pet's mood. The recording file is deleted from your device immediately after analysis completes or fails. Fahim does not provide medical diagnoses or treatment or medication recommendations. A health alert only recommends seeing a veterinarian.

Audio and email are not sent to external services until you accept this consent. Advertising may use the included advertising services according to your device settings and any consent required by law.

You can request deletion of your account and its data in Settings through Delete Account. After publication, a web link for deletion requests will also be available on the store listing.

For privacy questions, use the contact method published on the app's Google Play listing.
